### 5‑Day Instagram Content Plan (Launch)

| Day | Post Type & Hook | Caption Skeleton | Visual Prompt | CTA |
|-----|------------------|------------------|---------------|-----|
| 1 | **Teaser** – logo reveal on black  | "Meet the face of Faded Archive 👀 #ComingSoon #TeeLife" | Logo on sleek black background, subtle glow | “Stay tuned for the drop” |
| 2 | **Behind‑the‑scenes** – tee printing | “From sketch to stitch. Here’s how your tee gets made 🧵📦 #BTS #PrintProcess” | Machine in action, close‑up of thread & fabric | “Tell us which design should be first” |
| 3 | **Product highlight** – first design | “First drop: ‘Midnight Wanderer’ in charcoal + navy. Limited edition 🌌 #Fashion #LimitedRun” | Model wearing tee, spotlight on design | “Pre‑order now” |
| 4 | **User‑generated content** – customer photo (or mockup) | “We love seeing your style! Snap a pic in #FadedArchive.” | Collage of fan pics (permission‑based) | “Show us yours” |
| 5 | **Launch day** – discount & shop link | “It’s LIVE! 10% off all tees for 48h. Use code LAUNCH10 🎉 #ShopNow” | Shop front, “10% OFF” badge, link | “Shop link in bio” |

- Keep each caption under **150 words** (standing rule from earlier).  
- Use British English spellings.  
- All posts should use the same warm‑tone, slightly edgy brand voice.

### eBay UK Fees for Clothing

| Fee Type | Rate (approx.) | Notes |
|----------|----------------|-------|
| **Insertion fee** | £0.30 – £0.34 per listing *per day* (first 50 listings free per month) | Free for first 50 listings per month. |
| **Final Value Fee (FVF)** | 10.95% of the *sale* price (up to £250) | Includes payment processing fee. |
| **PayPal‑related fee** | 2.9% + £0.30 per transaction | Only if selling through PayPal. |
| **Optional: Store subscription** | From £9.95/mo | Reduces FVF to 4–8% and gives free listing extensions. |
| **International shipping** | Separate shipping fee | Note British post rates. |

**Quick calculation for a £20 tee:**

- FVFE: £20 × 10.95% = £2.19  
- PayPal: £20 × 2.9% + £0.30 = £0.98  
- Total fee ≈ **£3.17** → Net ≈ **£16.83**.
